issues.detail: The Greek text says 'λεγοντος' (saying), but the Vietnamese translation omits the subject/agent of the saying. While 'nói rằng' is present, the structure 'nghe một cái khác... nói rằng' suggests 'hearing another [thing] saying', whereas the Greek implies hearing another [person] saying.

The Vietnamese 'một cái khác' translates 'αλλου' (another) as 'another thing/item'. In this context, 'αλλου' refers to 'another [person]' (another voice). Translating it as 'một cái khác' (another thing) changes the nature of the subject from a person to an object.
